title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 5, section 122 (Quinsam Coal Mine)
heading: Quinsam Coal Mine
sourceText:
Schedule 5 No Shooting Areas (Section 6)
Quinsam Coal Mine
122 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in M.U. 1-10 that is contained within the following described boundaries: Commencing at 49° 57' 00" north latitude and 125° 30' 00" west longitude; thence due East to 126° 26' 30" west longitude; thence due South to 49° 54' 30" north latitude; thence due West to 125° 30' 00" west longitude; thence due North to the point of commencement. [en. B.C. Reg. 211/93, s. 8 (b).]
sourceVersion: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026
